# CodeY CMS

> CodeY CMS is a free, self-hosted visual CMS for editable, server-rendered websites generated by people or AI agents.

Canonical website: https://usecodey.com/cms
Source: https://github.com/fpointerdev/codey-cms
License: GPL-2.0-or-later
Stable release feed: https://github.com/fpointerdev/codey-cms/releases/latest/download/stable.json

## Agent entrypoints

- [Generated-site contract](https://github.com/fpointerdev/codey-cms/blob/main/docs/generated-site-contract.md): WebsiteSpec 1.0, builder, SSR, and acceptance rules.
- [AI agent integration](https://github.com/fpointerdev/codey-cms/blob/main/docs/ai-agent-integration.md): MCP tools and client configuration.
- [Self-host installation](https://github.com/fpointerdev/codey-cms/blob/main/docs/self-host-installation.md): signed stable installation and updates.
- [API contract](https://github.com/fpointerdev/codey-cms/blob/main/docs/api-contract.md): authenticated runtime APIs and permissions.
- [Content modeling](https://github.com/fpointerdev/codey-cms/blob/main/docs/content-modeling.md): collections and declarative extensions.
- [Security checklist](https://github.com/fpointerdev/codey-cms/blob/main/docs/security-checklist.md): production boundaries.

## Important boundaries

- CodeY CMS is self-hosted; CodeY generation and delivery are separate services.
- Generated content must use WebsiteSpec 1.0 and generator-safe registered elements.
- The public MCP connector is read-only and has no customer-site access.
- Do not claim a site, checkout, email, or other browser journey works until acceptance tests pass.
